function.arguments: {"finding": "The treatment and control groups are significantly imbalanced on both site and severity. The chi-square test for severity shows a strong association (chi2 ≈ 178.5, p ≈ 0), indicating that treatment patients were much more likely to have moderate or severe disease. Since severity is likely a strong predictor of response (mild cases respond better), this imbalance confounds the treatment effect. The observed lower response in the treatment group may be due to higher severity, not the treatment itself. Without adjustment, the raw difference in proportions is biased.", "implication": "We cannot report the raw difference in proportions as a valid treatment effect.
